data.name: Zebedee
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Zebedee is derived from the Hebrew word ‘zabhad’, meaning ‘gift of God’. In the New Testament, Zebedee is the name of two brothers who were disciples of Jesus. They were fishermen by trade and the name is believed to mean 'house of fish'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and spiritual growth through hard work.

in_hebrew.name: זבדי
in_hebrew.meaning: הנראה, הנמצא, הנראה, המצוי, המצוי, הנראה, המצוי,
in_hebrew.long_meaning: באופן ריאלי, זבדי היה שמו של גורשון, אביו של שמעון זבדי, שהיה דייג, ואחד מאבות השלושת, ודמות מפתח בבשורה. השם 'זבדי' נחשב לאחד השמות המעטים בברית החדשה, ולעיתים קרובות מצוין כ'הזבדי', 'זבדיה' או 'זבדיאל'.

in_greek.name: Ζεβεδαῖος
in_greek.meaning: ὁ φαίνων, ὁ ὑποκείμενος, ὁ καταδεχόμενος, ὁ ὑπομένων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ Ζεβεδαῖος ἦταν ἕνας ἀπὸ τῶν τριῶν ἀδελφῶν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ὁ ὁποῖος ἦταν γιος τοῦ ἰατροῦ Ζεβεδαίου. Ὁ ὄνομα 'Ζεβεδαῖος' ἔχει ἀπὸ τὴν ἑλληνιστικήν ἑρμηνείαν τοῦ ἑβραϊκοῦ 'זבדי', ὁ ὁποῖος σημαίνει 'ὁ φαίνων, ὁ ὑποκείμενος, ὁ καταδεχόμενος, ὁ ὑπομένων'.

in_latin.name: Zebedaeus
in_latin.meaning: qui apparit, qui patitur, qui tolerat
in_latin.long_meaning: Zebedaeus, nomen Hebraicum, significat 'qui apparit, qui patitur, qui tolerat'. In Evangelio secundum Matthaeum et Evangelio secundum Lucam, Zebedaeus, pater Simonis Zebedaei et Iacobi Zebedaei, fuit unus ex disciplulis Domini Iesu Christi, qui erant in mare pescantes. Nomen Zebedaei, sicut nominum aliorum in Evangelio, habet significatum profundum in contextu scripturarum sacrarum.

in_english.name: Zebedee
in_english.meaning: the appearing, the one who is seen, the sufferer, the one who tolerates
in_english.long_meaning: Zebedee, a Hebrew name, means 'the appearing, the one who is seen, the sufferer, the one who tolerates'. In the New Testament, Zebedee, the father of Simon Zebedee and James Zebedee, was one of Jesus' disciples who were fishermen. The name Zebedee, like other names in the New Testament, has a deep meaning in its scriptural context, highlighting the importance of perseverance and patience in one's faith journey.

biblical_reference.note: Zebedee is mentioned in the New Testament as the father of two of Jesus' disciples, Simon Zebedee and James Zebedee, who were fishermen.

saint_reference.note: Saint Zebedee is venerated as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox Church and the Roman Catholic Church.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zebedee was prominent in the early Christian faith due to the presence of two brothers with this name in the New Testament. They were part of the inner circle of disciples who witnessed Jesus' transfiguration and were granted a special request by him at the crucifixion. Additionally, the name was carried by various saints throughout history, including St. Zebedee, the archbishop of Canterbury during the early Middle Ages.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zebedee holds a significant spiritual meaning as it is derived from the Hebrew word ‘zabhad’, meaning ‘gift of God’. This makes it a reminder of the Divine Providence that nurtures and protects each individual. For the two brothers in the New Testament, their name served as a testament to their faith as they left their fishing business to follow Jesus, the ultimate gift of God. This name can serve as an inspiration for those seeking to fully surrender to God's will and embrace the spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: The New Testament of the Bible mentions Zebedee as a fisherman from Galilee, the brother of James and John, and the father of James the Lesser and Judas the son of James. He is depicted as a partner in the fishing business with his sons and with Simon Peter and Andrew.

The Talmud, a collection of Jewish religious and historical texts, refers to Zebedee as a descendant of King Jehoiachin and an important priestly family in Jerusalem. This reference is likely from the 3rd or 4th century AD.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Zebedee continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Zebedee in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Zebedee, which means "House of Fish". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Zebedee may symbolize the duality and variety in Christian life. Its origin comes from the Aramaic word "zabdi" meaning "gift of God," reflecting the divine providence in all aspects of existence. Moreover, Zebedee was the name of two brothers in the New Testament, representing the unity and companionship among brethren in their spiritual journey.
